exposure: maternal characteristics (e.g., diabetes mellitus, chronic hypertension, gestational diabetes, preterm premature rupture of membranes)
pharmacologic factors (e.g., use of methyldopa, metformin, thyroxine)
cohort: The study included 438 pregnant women with singleton live pregnancies between 28-40 weeks of gestation, excluding those with fetal anomalies.
finding: Maternal and fetal levels of TSP-1 and VEGF were significantly correlated and influenced by various clinical and pharmacologic factors, suggesting their potential as early biomarkers for pregnancy complications and maternal-fetal health.
